Operational excellence including operator runbooks, simpler node configuration, observability and logging, and an improved TUI

request.what: Funding for IO: Hydra to deliver a feature-complete and hardened Hydra v2 across performance optimization, operational excellence, ecosystem support, and developer experience workstreams.

claims.claim: Hydra is described as the only production-grade Layer 2 on Cardano and a state-channel scaling solution with L1 settlement backstops.
The proposal requests ₳5,100,781 and says the funding will be milestone-gated with independent third-party assurance and Intersect administrative treasury governance.
Hydra is already running or has powered workloads for Delta DeFi, Masumi, Hydra Doom, Glacier Drop, Intersect voting infrastructure, VTech Labs, Blockfrost, and Midgard.
The proposal claims Hydra provides sub-second finality, near-zero or zero internal fees, high throughput, and L1-grade settlement guarantees.
The proposal states Cardano L1 has over two hours of finality, approximately $0.17 per transaction, and roughly 7 to 10 TPS, while competitors offer faster finality, lower fees, and higher TPS.
The proposal claims the requested work will deliver four workstreams: performance optimization, operational excellence, ecosystem support, and maintenance and developer experience.
The proposal claims performance optimization will produce 2x to 10x improvements in snapshot signing and memory profile and reduce L1 fees through on-chain contract optimization.
The proposal claims Hydra applications can grow Cardano activity, TVL, users, transactions, throughput capacity, reliability, uptime, and annual protocol revenue.
The proposal claims Hydra head lifecycle transactions and optionally routed internal head fees can create usage-linked L1 fee accrual that scales with adoption.
The proposal lists provisional users under evaluation including Bodega Market, Atlas Defi, Wingriders, Houselink, and European Public Network.

summary: The anchor document presents a large treasury request for Hydra v2 hardening and adoption work, with many high-materiality technical, adoption, and economic claims but limited embedded evidence, budget detail, feasibility analysis, alternatives analysis, failure-mode analysis, or community impact analysis.
